name: CISA AA22-138B VMWare Workspace (TA1)
desc: Threat Actor 1 exploited VMWare Workspace ONE Access through various methods

acts.d: Freemarker targeted by attackers to send a customized GET request URI to a vulnerable server
server downloads a malicious shell script to VMWare Workspace ONE Access
attackers downloaded jtest.jsp to the server's web directory from the IP address
Malicious script run with root privileges (run with SUDO)
script collects sensitive files, including user names, passwords, master keys, and firewall rules and stored them in a tar ball
collected information stored in a tar ball file on the server
deleted files and logs, including fd86ald0.pem, localhost_access logs, logs associated with the VMWare Horizon application, and greenbox logs for the date of activity
GET requests are used to exfiltrate data
sensitive data stored in tar ball is exfiltrated by GET request
